title: England's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for England in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only caps from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Raheem Sterling: Raheem Sterling is 11th with 82, just outside.
notes.Rio Ferdinand: Rio Ferdinand has 73 since 2000 (81 in all).
notes.Michael Owen: Michael Owen has 71 since 2000 (89 in all).
notes.Gary Neville: Gary Neville has 51 since 2000 (85 in all).
notes.David Beckham: David Beckham won 115 caps; 27 came before 2000, so 88 count here.
notes.Peter Shilton: Peter Shilton's caps all came before 2000.
notes.Frank Lampard: Frank Lampard won 106 caps; his first, in October 1999, doesn't count here.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026. Cross-checked against England Football Online's appearance list at 18 July 2026 (Kane 121, Walker 96, Stones 94, Pickford 91, Henderson 91, Sterling 82, Rice 80) and the by-year tables in Wikipedia articles for the straddlers (Beckham 88 from 2000, Lampard 105). Henderson is 91 on EFO and Wikipedia, 90 on Transfermarkt; 91 is used, and he is 8th or 9th either way.
